name: Automatic IV Decomposition with Optimal Viewpoint Preview
definition: Interval Volumes (IVs) are defined as feature subvolumes where each IV corresponds to a link in the level-set graph, enabling the investigation of nested relationships between decomposed volumes.
summary: Automatic IV Decomposition with Optimal Viewpoint Preview generates an interactive animation that peels off nested volume layers while dynamically optimizing the camera path to minimize occlusions between remaining features.
